watch.summary: A streamer playing a hiding game realizes his giant character choice makes hiding under tables impossible.

beats.what: Streamer admits he chose to play as a fat/large character.
Streamer runs around showing his huge avatar and realizes how easy he will be to spot.
Streamer tries to crouch and hide under a long dining table.
He realizes he cannot crouch or fit under the table at all.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Can I hide under the table? No I can't?
watch.why: The humor comes from the creator's self-inflicted handicap in a hide-and-seek game. His realization that his oversized avatar can't fit under simple tables creates a lighthearted, relatable moment of regret.
